info.name: [V1] Post Swap Route For Encoded Data

items.docs: Get the swap's calldata to be sent to the KyberSwap router contract. The request body must contain the `routeSummary` as exactly returned by [V1] Get Swap Route along with the additional tx related parameters. Please refer to [Supported Exchanges And Networks](https://docs.kyberswap.com/getting-started/supported-exchanges-and-networks) for the full list of supported networks.

params.name: tokenIn
params.description:
Address of the input token 
`0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE` in case of native token

params.name: tokenOut
params.description:
Address of the output token 
`0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE` in case of native token

params.name: amountIn
params.description: Amount of the input token (in wei)

params.name: includedSources
params.description: DEX IDs included in the route, separated by comma

params.name: excludedSources
params.description: DEX IDs excluded from the route, separated by comma

params.name: excludeRFQSources
params.description: Exclude RFQ sources

params.name: onlyScalableSources
params.description: Exclude unscalable sources and only use sources that accept scaling input amounts

params.name: onlyDirectPools
params.description: Only routes directly from tokenIn to tokenOut (without hop tokens)

params.name: onlySinglePath
params.description: Determines whether to only return single-path route

params.name: gasInclude
params.description: Determines whether gas costs are accounted for when searching for best route. Defaults to true

params.name: gasPrice
params.description: Custom gas price in wei used when searching for the best swap route. Use result from eth_gasPrice otherwise

params.name: feeAmount
params.description:
Fee amount(s) to be collected.
If `isInBps` = `true`, `feeAmount` is the percentage of fees to take with base unit = 10000, i.e `feeAmount` = 10 and `isInBps` = `true` then fee = 0.1%;
If `isInBps` = `false`, `feeAmount` is the amount of token to take as fee, i.e `feeAmount` = 10 and `isInBps` = 'false' then fee = 10 token weis.
It also accepts a comma-separated list of numbers to support multiple fee receivers, for example: feeAmount=10,20

params.name: chargeFeeBy
params.description:
Indicates that the API client wants to charge fee by input token (`currency_in`) or output token (`currency_out`).
Default is empty whereby no fee is charged.

params.name: isInBps
params.description: if true, fee is taken in bps of the amount in/out, instead of absolute wei value

params.name: feeReceiver
params.description: The API client's wallet address(es) to receive fee (if `chargeFeeBy` is not empty). It can accept a comma separated list of addresses to collect multiple fee amounts into multiple addresses

params.name: origin
params.description: The origin address (user wallet) of the swap tx. Include this to get access to exclusive pools and rates

items.docs: Find the best route to swap from `tokenIn` to `tokenOut`, supporting all liquidity sources including RFQ. Use this API to get a route preview before confirming the swap. The route returned can then be combined with transaction specific params in the `POST` API payload to get the encoded data for submission to the KyberSwap router contract. Refer to [Supported Exchanges And Networks](https://docs.kyberswap.com/getting-started/supported-exchanges-and-networks) for the full list of supported networ

info.name: Get Swap Info with Encoded Data

params.name: tokenIn
params.description:
Address of the input token 
`0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE` in case of native token

params.name: tokenOut
params.description:
Address of the output token 
`0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE` in case of native token

params.name: amountIn
params.description: Amount of the input token (in wei)

params.name: dexes
params.description: DEX IDs included in the route, separated by comma

params.name: onlyScalableSources
params.description: Exclude unscalable sources and only use sources that accept scaling input amounts

params.name: gasInclude
params.description: Determines whether gas costs are accounted for when searching for best route

params.name: gasPrice
params.description: Custom gas price in wei used when searching for the best swap route. Use result from eth_gasPrice otherwise

params.name: slippageTolerance
params.description:
This is the amount of slippage the user can accept for his trade. The unit is bps (1/100 of 1%).
The value is in ranges [0, 2000], with 10 meaning 0.1%, and 0.1 meaning 0.001%.
If no value is provided, slippageTolerance will be set to 0.

params.name: chargeFeeBy
params.description:
Indicates that the API client wants to charge fee by input token (`currency_in`) or output token (`currency_out`).
Default is empty whereby no fee is charged.

params.name: feeReceiver
params.description: The API client's wallet address to receive fee (if `chargeFeeBy` is not empty)

params.name: isInBps
params.description: if true, fee is taken in bps of the amount in/out, instead of absolute wei value

params.name: feeAmount
deadline
params.description: Deadline (in Unix epoch second) for the transaction to be executed by. Default will be +20 minute. Cannot be in the past.

params.name: to
params.description: Address to receive the output token

params.name: clientData
params.description: Json string to include your client id in the source field if header cannot be used

params.name: referral
params.description: Referral info to include in the swap transaction's ClientData event.

params.name: permit
params.description:
Encoded token's permit calldata to swap without approving.
The permit's spender should be the routerAddress returned in the [Get Swap Route](#get-route) API response. See /permit

params.name: ignoreCappedSlippage
params.description: If true, the slippage tolerance can be any value. Please use with caution.

items.docs:
Retrieve the information about a Swap between 2 tokens with encoded data to submit to KyberSwap router contract. RFQ liquidity sources are not supported.
Please refer to [Supported Exchanges And Networks](https://docs.kyberswap.com/getting-started/supported-exchanges-and-networks) for the full list of supported networks.
